_comment: Four defects, each independently fatal. (1) ability_type ATTACK_REACTION on a Ninja ACTION - Attack card, so nothing fired; it is TRIGGERED/ON_ATTACK. (2) amount 'CHAIN_HIT_COUNT' was an invented string resolving to 0, so the draw drew nothing; 'X is the number of attacks that have hit this combat chain' is COUNT_CHAIN_LINKS with hit:true. (3) REORDER_REF with ref HAND reorders cards ALREADY IN A DECK (it filters on `c in deck.cards`), so with hand cards it silently no-opped; putting cards from hand on top is PUT_HAND_CARD_TOP. (4) COMBO_CONTAINS is the looser substring variant; LAST_CHAIN_ATTACK matches the card name exactly.
